text: Program Description Length of Schooling and Degree Duration: 3-6 years Degree: Doctor of Engineering Objectives This program aims to cultivate students to master solid and broad basic theories along with in-depth and systematic knowledge of Electrical Engineering, to understand the professional and cutting-edge trends of this discipline; to equip students with the capacity of doing independent research and having a preliminary ability of conducting the relatively large-scale scientific research and technology development projects or the ability to solve and explore economics and social developmen tissues , to make creative achievements in science or expertise , to be quali fied to undertake the scientific research, teaching and management of this discipline or related areas. Brief Introduction of Discipline , Major and Research Direction The first- level discipline of Electrical Engineering includes 6 sub-disciplines, Motor and electric appliances, Electric power system and its automation, High voltage and insulation technology, Power electronics and power transmission , Electrician theory and new technology , Electrical information technology (self-designed) , among which, the Electric power system and its automation is the national key discipline and the first-level discipline electrical engineering is the Beijing’s key discipline, the cultivation task is undertaken by the School of Electrical and Electronic Engineering in North China Electr ic Power Uni versity. Main research directions: I.Power system analysis and control 2.Power system protection and safety defense 3.Power transformat ion and active distribution network 4.Advanced transmission and conversion technology 5.Intelligent monitoring diagnosis and big data analysis of electrical equipment 6.Electrical insulation and electromagnetic environment 7.Motor system and control 8.Energy and power economy 9.The characteristics of new energy power system and multisource complementary 10. Energy Internet communication and information security
